answer.headline: Revenue fell beyond normal variation during the week of Christmas due to broad holiday demand shifts.
explanation: Revenue dropped significantly compared to the previous week, driven by simultaneous declines in both traffic and conversion rates.
The change occurred site-wide rather than being isolated to any specific segment or tracking failure, coinciding with Christmas Eve and Christmas Day.
All major funnel stages experienced decreases in performance, aligning with typical seasonal slowdowns during the holiday period.
answer.next_step: Monitor post-holiday traffic recovery and seasonal shopping patterns to assess return to baseline.
